# `todo` commands

## `todo complete`

Mark a to-do done. It records who completed it and when, leaves the open lists, and stays in `todo list --status done`. A done to-do can be opened again with `todo update --status open`.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | note |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/todo.complete` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow todo complete 01JTODO0000000000000000000 --company "Demo Plumbing Co"`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "todo complete", "input": {"todo": "01JTODO0000000000000000000"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `todo` | `TODO` | string | yes | no | — | The to-do, by id.; minimum length 1; maximum length 200 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |

## `todo create`

Create a to-do: something to be done by a date, assigned to a person or an agent -- the anchor's To Do note. `title` says what; `notes` the details; `due_date` defaults to today; `priority` is high, medium (the default) or low. `assignee` is a username or user id of a member of this company, or "me"; omitted, the to-do is yours. An agent assigned a to-do finds it with `todo list --mine`. `link_type` and `link` say what it is about: a customer, a vendor, a document (transaction id) or a memorized transaction.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | note |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/todo.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow todo create --title "Call Rivera about the deposit" --due-date 2026-11-03 --assignee night-agent --priority high --link-type customer --link "Rivera Construction" --company "Demo Plumbing Co"`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "todo create", "input": {"title": "Call Rivera about the deposit", "due_date": "2026-11-03", "assignee": "night-agent", "priority": "high", "link_type": "customer", "link": "Rivera Construction"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

| `notes` | `--notes` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Details: what to do and anything the person doing it needs to know. |
| `due_date` | `--due-date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | When it is due; omitted, today in the company's timezone. |

| `link_type` | `--link-type` | literal["customer", "vendor", "transaction", "memorized"] \| null | no | yes | null | Kind of record it is about: customer, vendor, transaction (any document) or memorized (a memorized transaction). |

## `todo list`

List to-dos, soonest due first and high priority first within a day. Open ones by default; `--mine` lists only those assigned to whoever asks (how an agent picks up its work), `--assignee` someone else's, `--due-by` those due by a date, `--status` done, inactive or all. A to-do the scheduler assigned (an automatic memorized entry that needs a person) carries its `source_ref`.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | note |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/todo.list` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow todo list --mine --company "Demo Plumbing Co"`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "todo list", "input": {"mine": true}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mine` | `--mine` | boolean | no | no | false | Only the to-dos assigned to whoever is asking -- how an agent finds its own work. |
| `assignee` | `--assignee` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only the to-dos assigned to this username or user id. |
| `status` | `--status` | literal["open", "done", "inactive", "all"] | no | no | "open" | Which to-dos: open (the default), done, inactive or all. |
| `due_by` | `--due-by` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only the to-dos due on or before this date. |
| `link_type` | `--link-type` | literal["customer", "vendor", "transaction", "memorized"] \| null | no | yes | null | Only the to-dos about this kind of record. |
| `link` | `--link` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only the to-dos about this record (needs link_type). |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 100 | minimum 1; maximum 500 |

## `todo update`

Change a to-do: title, details, due date, priority, assignee, what it is about, or its status (open, or inactive when it no longer needs doing). Fields you do not name stay as they are; null clears notes, the assignee or the link. Mark it done with `todo complete`.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | note |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/todo.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow todo update 01JTODO0000000000000000000 --due-date 2026-11-05 --expected-version 1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co"`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "todo update", "input": {"todo": "01JTODO0000000000000000000", "due_date": "2026-11-05", "expected_version": 1}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `todo` | `TODO` | string | yes | no | — | The to-do, by id.; minimum length 1; maximum length 200 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `title` | `--title` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New title. |
| `notes` | `--notes` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New details; null clears them. |
| `due_date` | `--due-date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New due date. |
| `priority` | `--priority` | literal["high", "medium", "low"] \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `assignee` | `--assignee` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New assignee: a username or user id, or "me"; null leaves it unassigned. |
| `link_type` | `--link-type` | literal["customer", "vendor", "transaction", "memorized"] \| null | no | yes | null | New kind of linked record; null with link null removes the link. |
| `link` | `--link` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `status` | `--status` | literal["open", "inactive"] \| null | no | yes | null | open, or inactive when it no longer needs doing. Use `todo complete` to mark it done. |
